test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the underlined word.**

The crowd __cheered__ the cricketer.
solution: The correct answer is '**Encouraged**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word '**cheered**' is '**encouraged**'. • **Cheered**: to shout to show that you like something or to encourage somebody who is taking part in competition, sport, etc. (किसी को स्‍पर्धा, खेल आदि में प्रोत्‍साहित करने के लिए चिल्‍लाना आदि) • *Example: Everyone **cheered** the winner as he crossed the finishing line.* • **Encouraged**: to give hope, support or confidence to somebody. [(किसी को) प्रोत्‍साहित करना; (किसी की) हिम्‍मत बढ़ाना] • *Example: The teacher **encouraged** her students to ask questions.* **​Correct Answer:__** *encouraged.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Distracted**: unable to give your full attention to something because you are worried or thinking about something else. (व्‍याकुल या अनमना, चिंता के कारण जिसका ध्यान अन्‍यत्र हो) • **Dropped**: to let something fall. (गिराना, गिरने देना) • **Attracted**: to cause somebody/something to go to something or give attention to something. (आकर्षित करना; आकृष्‍ट करना; लुभाना) 3c:T96a, The correct answer is '**Granary**'.
